source: RBI Monetary Policy (https://www.rbi.org.in/) + MOSPI CPI via https://data.gov.in/
note: Bundled pack. `repo_rate`/`stance` track the latest RBI MPC decision; `cpi_yoy` is refreshed at build time by scripts/refresh_rates.py from the free data.gov.in CPI series. `regime` is derived (repo vs prev_repo). `sector_sensitivity` is a maintained crosswalk of how rate-sensitive each sector is (signed magnitude, both NSE-Industry and yfinance taxonomies); the tailwind is regime_sign x sensitivity. Update repo_rate/stance after each MPC. Not investment advice.
